verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਖਾਂਡ ਚੂਨ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਹੋਤ ਘਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਪੈ ਪਾਹੁਨਾ ਕੇ ਆਏ ਪੂਰੀ ਕੈ ਖੁਵਾਇ ਖਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise khaa(n)dd choon ghirat hot ghar bikhai pai paahunaa ke aae pooree kai khuvai khaieeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as flour, sugar and oil are kept at home, and on arrival of some guests, sweet dishes are prepared, served and eaten.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਚੀਰ ਹਾਰ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਕਨਕ ਆਭਰਨ ਪੈ  ਬਿਆਹੁ ਕਾਜ ਸਾਜਿ ਤਨ ਸੁਜਨ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise cheer haar mukataa kanak aabharan pai  biaahu kaaj saaj tan sujan dhikhaieeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as beautiful dresses, pearl necklace and gold jewellery are in possession but are worn on special occasions like marriage and are shown to others.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਮਾਨਿਕ ਅਮੋਲ ਹੋਤ ਹਾਟ ਹੀ ਮੈਂ  ਗਾਹਕੈ ਦਿਖਾਇ ਬਿੜਤਾ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise heeraa maanik amol hot haaT hee mai(n)  gaahakai dhikhai biRataa bisekh paieeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as valuable pearls and jewels are kept in the shop, but shopkeeper shows them to the customer to sell and earn profit.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਬਾਨੀ ਲਿਖ ਪੋਥੀ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਰਾਖੀਅਤ  ਮਿਲ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੜਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੫੬੨॥
verses.translit_en: taise gurbaanee likh pothee baa(n)dh raakheeat  mil gursikh paR sun liv laieeaai ||562||

en.bdb: Similarly Gurbani is written in a book form, it is bound and preserved. But when the Sikhs of Guru assemble in a congregation, that book is read and heard and it helps one attach the mind in the holy feet of the Lord.
